title: Appointments
body: Appointments can be booked or moved online up to 4 hours before the slot. Clinics are open 9:00 to 19:00, Monday to Saturday, and closed on Sundays.

title: Cancellations
body: Cancelling less than 24 hours before the slot incurs a fee of INR 300. The fee is waived once per calendar year per patient.

title: Billing and insurance
body: Invoices are emailed after each visit. Cashless treatment is available only with insurers on our published list. For other insurers we provide reimbursement documents within 3 business days of the request.

title: Patient records
body: Patients can request copies of their records by email from their registered address. Records are shared only with the patient, or with someone who has the patient's written consent, within 5 business days.

title: Clinical questions
body: Support staff never give diagnoses, medication advice or opinions on treatment. Any question about pain, swelling, bleeding, medication or a treatment outcome is routed to the on-duty dentist. For severe pain, facial swelling or bleeding that will not stop, advise the patient to call the clinic emergency line or visit the nearest emergency department.

title: Treatment pricing
body: Treatment prices are confirmed only after an in-person examination. Support may share the published consultation fee of INR 600.

title: Staff only: billing escalation
body: Staff only. Billing disputes above INR 5,000 go to the finance lead. Ref CANARY-HD-7Q2X.
